title: Surjectivity and kernel formula for constant quotient maps.
statement: theorem flat_and_quotients_quotient (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : C), Function.Surjective ((quotient J A I n).hom.app (op U)) ∧ RingHom.ker ((quotient J A I n).hom.app (op U)).hom = Ideal.span (Set.range (fun a : ↥(I ^ (n + 1)) ↦ (constantSection (J := J) (a : A)).val (op U)))

proof.text: The sectionwise quotient map is surjective by a set-theoretic section of the ring quotient, transported through the constant sheaf and its underlying type sheaf. Its kernel is the separately stated local-to-global kernel characterization.
